tiers.action: Stop. Call 000 or go to your nearest emergency department.
items: Loss of bladder or bowel control, numbness in the groin or saddle area, or new leg weakness
Sudden severe pain with a feeling something gave way, or a sudden change in how your back sits or moves
Chest pain, fainting, or a racing or irregular heartbeat
Trouble breathing, or you can't be woken normally
Severe belly pain with vomiting that won't stop
Thoughts of harming yourself or someone else

tiers.action: Contact your GP or pain specialist today, or call healthdirect 1800 022 222.
items: Any new numbness, tingling or weakness, even mild
A new pain pattern: new location, burning or electric quality, or pain that wakes you and won't ease with position
Fever, unexplained sweats, or feeling unwell alongside back pain
Dizziness or fainting on standing, or agitation, tremor, sweating or a very fast heartbeat after a medication change
Pain after exercise that is different from usual or lasts longer than usual

expected_soreness.text: Mild, familiar muscle soreness in the areas trained, within my usual range, that eases with gentle movement and has settled by the next morning.
